_about: Neon Glow #52 (Top-100 rank 52, ref by jim.malingin, editing-business talk on a night-skyline set). White UPPERCASE heavy sans captions at chest height, the key phrase big in YELLOW, red glowing alarm words while the frame flips to black and white for a beat, neon-green revenue/UI cards, red boxed PROBLEM list and red-X 'not this' list. Podcast caps captions (keys yellow, reds red).

director.captions: podcast caps: captions.keys = the money/claim word per line (yellow), captions.reds = the alarm/problem words (red; the ref flips the frame to B&W under them, which podcast captions cannot do: see engine gaps). big beat with count for a price or number. list beat with stampAt for 'not this' lists.
